name: map-access-expr-test-6a04afad0c/map-access-expr-v
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get, remove.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; map:length, map:keys, map:hasKey, map:get, map:remove.
Expressions lists supported expressions but does not list typeof/type descriptor expressions.
reason: The asserted outputs require map.removeAll(), map.reduce() and map.removeIfHasKey(), which are absent from both the supported map langlib list and the supported langlib method-call list. These essential operations make the whole case a feature request even though basic map access and several other map operations are supported. The final typedesc rendering assertion also depends on an unlisted typeof expression.
test_design_notes: Assertions exercise map clearing, ordered value reduction and present/absent removal behavior, not just method availability.
